input.style_description: Royal Nizam-era grandeur with lush florals, golden arches, candlelight, and deep jewel tones — think Mughal opulence meets modern luxury.

style_bible.theme_location: A cinematic Royal Mughal wedding world inspired by Hyderabad’s Nizam-era palaces: carved marble halls, scalloped arches, and intimate candlelit courtyards, balancing historic grandeur with restrained modern luxury.
recurring_motifs: Scalloped Mughal arches with fine warm-burnished-gold detailing
Small clusters of ivory jasmine and pomegranate-toned roses
Glowing ivory candles in antique brass holders
Sheer aged-ivory fabric drifting softly through palace interiors
style_bible.lighting_mood: Romantic, low-contrast candlelight warmed by soft amber highlights; preserve rich teal, pomegranate, and mehendi tones without crushing shadows, and let gold details glow gently rather than sparkle. Keep skin tones natural and ivory marble softly luminous.
style_bible.composition_rules: Use a refined, symmetrical palace-inspired frame with the main architectural arch centred. Keep people, florals, and ceremonial details in the lower 45% of the frame; reserve the upper 55% as uncluttered, softly lit negative space for invitation text. Place decorative motifs near the edges, never behind names or event details, and maintain generous margins around all text.
style_bible.motion_style: Use imperceptibly slow, steady push-ins or shallow lateral parallax, with no abrupt pans or handheld shake. Let candle flames flicker subtly, sheer fabric drift at no more than 0.3× real speed, and loose petals descend sparsely and slowly. Keep the camera movement consistent across scenes and use a gentle fade between them.

scenes.scene_purpose: Set a romantic, regal mood with candlelit arches, jewel tones, and lush florals.
scenes.image_prompt: A cinematic, symmetrical Nizam-era palace courtyard in Hyderabad, framed by a centred scalloped Mughal arch with restrained warm-burnished-gold carving along its outer edges. Aged ivory marble glows softly in romantic candlelight, balanced with midnight peacock teal shadows, deep mehendi green, and touches of royal pomegranate. Keep all detail in the lower 45%: intimate clusters of ivory jasmine and pomegranate roses, glowing ivory candles in antique brass holders, and sheer aged-ivory fabric drifting gently beside the arch. Refined, historic grandeur with modern restraint; soft amber highlights, rich but uncrushed shadows, no people, no visual clutter. Portrait 9:16. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing anywhere. Upper 55% is a softly lit, low-contrast teal-and-ivory haze within the arch, clear and uncluttered for text overlay.

scenes.scene_purpose: Share the wedding celebration details and close with a warm invitation to join the couple.
